# Rndrng_Prvdr_Type -> provider class: # WHY THIS IS A FILE AND NOT A REGEX. "Is a certified nurse midwife an APP?" and
# "is an Ambulatory Surgical Center a rendering clinician?" are scientific
# choices that move the denominator of the URPS share. A choice buried in code
# is a choice nobody reviews. Same reasoning as cms_specialty_class.csv.
#   physician      An individual physician of any specialty. CMS has NO
#                  here pooled with generalists -- exactly as they are pooled
#                  under carrier specialty code 16 in the CADR archive. The
#                  URPS split therefore comes from the roster NPI join
#   APP            Advanced practice clinician billing under their own NPI.
#   facility       A non-individual entity. Not a rendering clinician at all.
# "Undefined Physician type" is CMS's bucket for an enrolled physician whose
# specialty is unclassified. It is a physician by the label's own terms and is
# classified as one; a roster-matched NPI landing here is still counted URPS
# because the roster is the authority on the individual.
# The domain is the provider types observed on the 22 procedural basket codes
# in the 2024 release. An unseen type must STOP the run rather than fall
# through to a default -- a refresh introducing "Female Pelvic Medicine and
# Reconstructive Surgery" would otherwise be silently swept into `physician`
# and the whole design point missed.
